A LETTER FROM MY HEART

For Kajal,
with honesty.

Some words are too important to remain unspoken.

A little story from my heart, written for someone who means so much to me.

Kajal, this isn’t an attempt to change your decision. It’s simply my way of expressing everything I couldn’t properly say.

Open my heart ↓
TAKE YOUR TIME · 01 / 09
02 — A THOUSAND LITTLE REASONS

Dil se ek chhoti si baat

Kajal, tum hamesha
khaas rahogi.

Hazaar chhoti wajahen, phir bhi alfaaz kam pad jaate hain.

DIL SE EK BAAT

Kajal, you are a beautiful part of my story.

Ek pyari baat · 1

03 — DIL SE MAAFI
♡

Ek khat jo pehle likhna chahiye tha

Dil se sorry,
Kajal.

Kajal, in chaar saalon mein meri wajah se tumhe kai baar takleef hui, aur tumhe bahut kuch sehna pada.

Tumhe woh sab sehna pada jo tum deserve nahi karti thi. Mere behaviour se tumhari feelings hurt hui aur tumhare self-respect ko bhi thes pahunchi.

Apne actions ke nateejon ke liye main tumhe kabhi blame nahi karunga. Mera iraada tumhe hurt karna nahi tha, par meri wajah se tumhe dard hua — aur iski zimmedari main leta hoon.

Mujhe us din ka sabse zyada afsos hai jab maine tum par chillaya aur abusive words kahe. Main kitna bhi gusse mein tha, mujhe tumse us tarah baat karne ka koi haq nahi tha.

Tum patience, izzat aur samajh deserve karti thi. Us din ke liye aur har us pal ke liye dil se sorry jab mere behaviour se tumhe bura laga ya tumhari izzat ko thes pahunchi.

Main apni galtiyon ko justify nahi karna chahta. Main unhe maanta hoon aur unse seekhna chahta hoon.

Tumhari feelings ko gusse nahi, samajhne ki zaroorat thi. Tumhare self-respect ko thes nahi, izzat milni chahiye thi.
04 — A LETTER FROM AASIF

Dil se, Kajal ke liye

Kajal ye mai tumhe manane ke liye nhi bana raha hu.. Ye esliye bna raha hu taaki jo baat mai samne se bol saku or tum meri baat ko samjh sako par aap Milne ke liye ready nhi thi.. koi baat nhi apki ye marzi hai espe hum force bhi nhi karenge.

Jo baat saamne
kehni thi…

Mai janta hu, 4 saal mai meri wajah se apko bahut kuch hurt hua or sehna pada or apke self-respect pe baat aai sab galti meri thi.. Mai ye nhi bolunga ki maine jaan bhuj kar sab kuch kya par hua toh mere wajah se hai na.

Galti insaan se hi hoti hai, aur mujhse hui hai. Mai dil se apni saari galti maan rha hu or ese accept karta hu. Pehle bhi bola tha, aaj phir bol rha hu. Es galti ke liye agar mujhe apke saamne zindagi bhar jhukna pade, to mai jhukne ko taiyyar hu. Or mai us din baat ko samjh nhi paya tha or tumpe chilla kar abused kar diya tha ye mujhe nhi karna chahiye tha.. us din ke liye dil se extremely sorry. Or sach mai hum dono ne ek dusre ko har ek situation mai support kiye or sabse jada aap ki ho ye ache se janta hu mai..

Ye bhi sach hai, jis time pe tumhe changes chahiye tha, us time pe maine puri koshish ki, par mai kar nhi paya. Ye bhi meri hi galti thi, mai ese bhi maanta hu.

Par es gap mai, mujhe bahut kuch realise hua hai. Tumhe hurt kar ke mai samjh gya hu, maine kya khoya hai. Ab maine sach mai apne anger ko, apne gusse ko tumhare liye control kar liya hai. Sirf or sirf tumhare liye maine khud ko badla hai. Tumne khud bola tha na, tumhe mera change dikh rha hai. Ye sach mai dikhawa nhi hai kajal, ye sach hai.

Kajal tumhare dil mai jitni bhi baat hai, everything tum mujhse khul kar share kar sakti ho. Koi bhi baat ho, achhi ya buri, gussa ya aansu ho.

Mai bilkul shanti se sunuga. Beech mai koi objection nhi karunga, koi behas nhi karunga, bilkul pyar se shant se har ek kuch sunuga. Jab bhi tumhara dil halka karna ho, tum bilkul bol sakti ho. Tumhare dil halka karna meri zimmedari hai, tumhe chup karna nhi meri babu.

Mere liye I love you ka matlab sirf ye bol dena nhi ki 'I love You' aur baat khatam.

Mere liye I Love You ka matlab hai- tumhari izzat, tumhara sukoon, tumhara care, tumhara pamper. Tumhe pyar se samjhna , har ek chhoti baat ko ek dusre se share karna. Subah se lekar raat tak, hum dono ne kya kya kiya or kya khaye ya nhi khaye, hum dono kha hai, ek dusre ko ache se samjhna or sab kuch jaana or kabhi mera sach mai koi bhi physically intention tumhare sath kabhi nhi rha hai dil se.. or mera pyar always apke liye izzat or sukoon se rha hai bachha.

Aur maine jitna blindly trust tumse pyar kiya hai, utna trust maine kisi or pe kya bhi nhi hai , aur karna bhi nhi hai. Kyuki meri genuine feelings tumhare liye hamesha rahegi meri baby.

Sach bolu baby, tumhare bina sab kuch adhoora sa lagta hai. Kuch bhi acha nhi lagta. Tum ho to sab sukoon bhara lagta hai , sab beautiful precious lagta hai. Tum nhi to kuch bhi nhi. Ye jo pyar , jo sukoon hum dono ne ek dusre ko diya hai, wo sukoon mujhe kahi or nhi milega or mujhe chahiye bhi nhi sirf or sirf apse chahiye meri jaan.

Es liye mai dil se chahta hu, hum phir se sath reh kar ek new journey start karein. Phir se sara sukoon ek dusre ke sath paa sakein. Purani wali galtiyon ke sath nhi, naye wale sukoon ke sath.

Ye mera wada hai tumse meri Kajal. Mai yhi hu, kahi nhi gya hu. Mai tumhe pehle se bhi zyada izzat, pyar, sukoon dunga. Aur es relationship ko pehle se bhi zyada precious banaunga meri jaan.

Aur haa, apke sath apke har ek tradition mai, har ek cheez mai apka sath dunga. Pooja se le kar sab kuch mai.

Tumhe sukoon chahiye, sukoon lelo. Space chahiye, space lelo. Mai tumhe disturb nhi karunga par jab apka dil halka ho jaye ache se. Apne baby ke pass aa jana bahut pyar or sukoon se rakhunga apko meri Kajal.

Tum khush raho always yhi dua hai meri..

Kajal I love you so much till the end of our whole life. I don't want to lose you, never ever, i will choose you again & again forever.

- Tumhara Aasif

03 — WHAT I MISSED
♡

Listening, finally

The pain I never
fully understood.

Kajal, I now understand that there were moments when you needed me to change, but I couldn’t consistently become the person you needed me to be.

I tried, but trying without consistent action was not enough. I understand that repeatedly getting hurt can make a person emotionally exhausted.

I don’t expect you to forget what happened just because I am apologising today. Your feelings are valid, your experiences matter, and you have every right to take the time you need.

An apology cannot erase the past, but it can be the beginning of taking responsibility for it.
04 — THE WORK AHEAD

A promise to myself

I’m learning
to become better.

This distance has given me time to reflect on myself. I have thought about my anger, my reactions, my words and the way I handled difficult situations.

I have started working on my anger and communication. I don’t want to claim that I have become perfect overnight. Real change requires consistency.

I want my actions to show the difference, not just my promises. I want to become a person who listens before reacting, understands before arguing and respects even during difficult conversations.

01

Patience

Learning to listen calmly, even when emotions are high.

02

Respect

Never allowing anger to become an excuse for hurtful words.

03

Consistency

Making positive changes a permanent part of my behaviour.

05 — WHAT LOVE MEANS

More than words

What love
means to me.

RespectHonouring who you are, always.
TrustCreating room for honesty and safety.
CareShowing up in the ordinary moments.
UnderstandingListening to what your feelings are saying.
Emotional safetyMaking space for truth without fear.
Small happinessNoticing the little things that brighten a day.
TogethernessSharing life while staying ourselves.
Honest communicationSpeaking gently, even when it is hard.

For me, I LOVE YOU is not just something to say.

It means respecting your individuality, caring about your happiness, understanding your emotions, remembering the little things and making sure that the person beside me feels respected and comfortable.

It means sharing the ordinary details of everyday life. It means asking how your day went, whether you ate, what made you smile and what might be troubling you.

It means building a relationship where both people can speak honestly without fear.

I don’t just want to tell you that I love you. I want my behaviour to make you feel loved and respected.
07 — IF LIFE ALLOWS

No pressure, just a hope

If life gives us
another chance…

Kajal, if someday you feel comfortable giving this relationship another chance, I would want us to begin differently. Not by forgetting everything that happened, but by learning from it.

I want better communication, more patience, more understanding and respect for each other’s boundaries. I want to support your traditions, your choices and the things that matter to you.

I want us to celebrate little happiness, share our everyday lives and build something healthier together. I know that trust cannot be demanded. It has to be earned through consistent actions.

I promise to listen.I promise to respect your feelings.I promise to communicate calmly.I promise to respect your space.I promise to keep improving myself.I promise never to use anger as an excuse for disrespect.
08 — WITH GRATITUDE

The last page, for now

Until my last page,
Kajal.

Kajal, I genuinely wish you happiness. I hope you always find reasons to smile, achieve your dreams and feel valued.

I cannot change what has already happened, but I can take responsibility for what I do from now on. I still care about you deeply, and I would be grateful if life ever gave us an opportunity to build something beautiful again.

But I also respect that your happiness and your decisions belong to you. Thank you for being an important part of my life and for all the memories we shared.

I would choose to love you with more patience, more maturity, more understanding and above all, more respect.

With love,
Your Aasif ♡
